# 3ngram v1.6.0

Minor: session-continuity hardening — the four preconditions the #166
validation bar requires before either triage mechanism can be enabled
anywhere. Both mechanisms remain **default-off**; this release makes turning
them on measurable and safe, not on.

## Changes

- **Closer scan bound by backlog, not history** (#183). A `needs_look`
  discriminator on `agent_sessions` lets settled `completed` rows leave the
  closer's partial index entirely; the late-commit `EXISTS` backstop is paid
  only on flagged rows. Migration `0034` backfills every existing `completed`
  row — open ones included — so no pre-migration event is lost.

- **Failing closer candidates back off** (#184). Per-row exponential backoff
  (`min(4h, 20min · 2^(n-1))`, migration `0035`), stamped once per exhausted
  worker job and computed atomically from the row at write time, so a
  consistently-failing row stops starving the sweep's batch window. Every
  resurrect path and both terminal write-backs reset it.

- **The Stop nudge age-guards a pending attempt** (#188). A `pending` attempt
  younger than `SESSION_TRIAGE_MIN_ATTEMPT_AGE_SECONDS` (default 30) declines
  as `pending-fresh` and withholds the attempt token, so a concurrent sibling
  Stop cannot finalize an attempt still in flight. A finalize-only delivery
  declares itself (`stopHookActive`) and is exempt, keeping short
  continuations' watermarks clean. Migration `0036`.

- **Erasure fences the closer** (#185). Account erasure bumps
  `activation_epoch` atomically with the redaction; the closer re-checks the
  epoch after its budget reservation, immediately before the gateway call, and
  the commitment resolve takes the row lock before reading the epoch — so an
  erasure abandons in-flight passes and post-erasure resolves cannot land. The
  honest residual is stated in the docs: one racing dispatch per
  concurrently-executing pass, each capped at the gateway timeout.

## Upgrade notes

Run `pnpm db:migrate` — migrations `0034`–`0036` (three new columns on
`agent_sessions`, no new table; the GDPR export gains the corresponding
fields). No breaking API change: new REST/schema surface is additive
(`pending-fresh` decline reason, optional `stopHookActive` on triage begin),
and `SESSION_CLOSER_ENABLED` / `THREENGRAM_STOP_NUDGE` stay off until the
validation bar in `docs/concepts/session-continuity.mdx` is measured.
